VELOAXIS MOUNTAIN BIKE B2B WEBSITE

Deployment
1. Upload every file and folder inside this dist folder to your web server's public directory.
2. Open index.html in a browser. The home page is the entry point.

Pages
- index.html: home page, factory/product carousel and quick quotation form
- products.html: filterable product catalogue
- factory.html: factory capability, quality process and OEM/ODM information
- contact.html: detailed enquiry form, attachment prompt, map and WhatsApp link
- admin.html: browser-local product/enquiry management demonstration

Before going live
- Replace sales@veloaxis.example with your business email.
- Replace the WhatsApp wa.me links in assets/site.js with your international WhatsApp number.
- Replace PASTE_VERIFICATION_CODE in index.html with your Google Search Console code.
- Configure a secure form, database and file-upload service to collect real enquiries.
- The included admin page demonstrates product CRUD and enquiry export inside one browser. A live multi-user backend requires server-side login, database and storage.

Languages
English is the primary language. The menu and main actions can switch to Arabic, Spanish, Chinese and Russian.
